Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
Can Pariah play Vulture's Buffet at obf?

Pariah
Clan: Abomination (group 2)
Capacity: 6
Disciplines: OBF PRO pot pre
Independent: During your master phase, discard a master card or tap Pariah. Pariah cannot take undirected actions other than hunting. He can enter combat with any minion as a  action. +1 strength. Scarce. Sterile.

Vulture's Buffet
Type: Action
Requires: Spiritus/Obfuscate
+1 stealth hunt action. If this hunt is successful, the acting vampire untaps.
[obf] Remove a minion or retainer in any Methuselah's ash heap from the game to move 1 blood to this vampire from the blood bank.
[spi] As [obf] above, but move 2 blood.
[SPI] As [spi] above, and you gain 1 pool.

Messages.Author: kschaefer
Messages.Body: Yes. Vulture's Buffet is a hunt action (by card text).

Messages.Author: Kraus
Messages.Body:
And for a wee bit more powerful hunt action you can look at Loki's Gift, or even Abactor if you're feeling lucky.

Name: Loki's Gift
[KoT:C]
Cardtype: Action
Discipline: Protean
+1 stealth hunt action.
[pro] Gain 1 blood and this card. This vampire can burn this card and 1 blood to get +1 stealth. A vampire can have only one Loki's Gift.
[PRO]  As above, and burn a blood from any vampire. This vampire may burn this card as above, or may burn it during a referendum to gain 2 votes.
Artist: Justin Norman

Name: Abactor
[Promo-20090401]
Cardtype: Action
+1 stealth hunt action.
Gain 5 blood. After successful resolution, a referendum is called to call a blood hunt on this vampire (independent of the action, just as if he or she had committed diablerie).
Artist: Juan Calle

Messages.Author: GreyB
Messages.Body:
Isn't Vulture's Buffet at obf also a Directed action? Does not state so on the card, but if it targets something of another Methuselah, it's automatically a Directed action. Right?

-1 Strength

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> GreyB wrote:
> Isn't Vulture's Buffet at obf also a Directed action? Does not state so on the card, but if it targets something of another Methuselah, it's automatically a Directed action. Right?
>
No.

See rulebook:
>
> Ash Heap: The discard pile. Cards that are burned or discarded are returned to their owner's ash heap. An action that targets an ash heap is always considered to be undirected.
>
